headline: 9 Michigan deals, $2.5M raised — led by Steelcase Inc

top_deals.summary: Steelcase Inc (SCS) disclosed merger/acquisition activity with HNI Corporation; filing cites a figure of ~$1.2B.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $2.5M sold across 5 Form D filings this week, down 94% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Swan Bravo Opportunity Fund, LLC (Portage, Residential) targeting $4M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Steelcase Inc (SCS) disclosed a deal with HNI Corporation. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan manufacturing & automotive assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $1.1M raised so far — led by Nitro Village LLC (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
